{{Quote|Democracy? Democracy is a philosophy for humans&mdash;they gave it to themselves and to no others. For 'alien' species, there has never been any choice but the manner of their subjugation.|Borsk Fey'lya, ''My Ar'krai''|<ref name="Essential Atlas" />}}
'''''My Ar'krai''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] [[Author/Legends|written]] by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]]<ref name="Essential Atlas" /> sometime prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="Death date">[[Borsk Fey'lya]] [[Death/Legends|sacrifices]] himself during the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. Thus ''My Ar'krai'' must have been [[Author/Legends|written]] by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> At least part of the book included a highly critical look at [[Human/Legends|Human]] contributions to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] politics, specifically the view that Humans restricted the benefits of [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] to just themselves. The book shared its name with the Bothan concept of [[ar'krai]], a genocidal vow<ref name="Essential Atlas" /> of total war that would not end until the enemy had been completely eliminated.<ref name="Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> Fey'lya's death during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a conflict fought between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]], inspired the Bothans to declare an ar'krai against the entire [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Essential Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
''My Ar'krai'' was introduced through a quote by Borsk Fey'lya in the section "The Political Galaxy" of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Essential Atlas" />
